title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Manhatan, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Vendndodhje Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Afer "Zogut te Zi", tek "Manhatan Residences ", shitet apartament 1+1, ne katin e 8 banim te nje kompleksi te ri ne faze ndertimi. Manhatan Residence eshte nje projekt multifunksional shume afer qendres se qytetit. Pozicionimi i kompleksit prane rruges kryesore e ben lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe te pershtatshem si per investim ashtu edhe per banim. Zona ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme. Organizimi i brendshem eshte si me poshte: salloni i ndenjes i lidhur me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon i madh.
title_en: At Manhattan Residence, 1+1 Apartment For Sale With Perfect Location!!!
description_en: Near "Zogut te Zi", at "Manhatan Residences", 1+1 apartment for sale, on the 8th floor of a new residential complex under construction. Manhattan Residence is a multifunctional project very close to the city center. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The internal organization is as follows: the living room connected to the kitchen corner and with access to the balcony, a bedroom, a toilet and a large balcony.
